function.name: fetch_user_details
function.description: Retrieves details of a user from the database based on the provided user identification criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user.

include_address.description: Specifies whether to include the user's address information in the response.

date_format.description: The format in which to return any date fields, such as 'YYYY-MM-DD' or 'MM/DD/YYYY'.

fields.description: A list of additional field names to include in the response, such as ['email', 'phone_number'].
